messages:
Ivy (Infra PM): quick follow-up from the all-hands: can we clarify APAC warm-pool behavior during holiday spikes? folks asked about routing order and what teams should configure. cc @Raj

Raj (VP Infra): short: warm-pool preferred for premium routes. routing: regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt. warm-reserve and burst credits sit between warm and preempt for eligible customers.

Maya (SRE): ops note: preempt detection fires at preempt_rate > 0.18 over 60s. when volatile, we bump min_warm for premium routes by +1 for 10m. CLI test: `infra/tools/preempt-sim --region=apac1 --spike=0.3 --dur=180 --observe`.

Liam (Support): can we get a one-line customer message for CS when a customer sees a brief latency blip? non-technical please.

Raj (VP Infra): suggestion: "During short regional demand spikes we briefly use lower-cost regional capacity to keep traffic flowing; premium plans stay on our local warm pool for low latency."

Ivy (Infra PM): action items: 1) Maya to share preempt dashboard link 2) add warm usage % to console (Platform) 3) Ivy to draft CS FAQ and post here. target: EOD Thu.

deploy-bot: rollout queued: autoscaler/v2 -> staging at 2024-06-01T14:00:00Z. monitors: warm-pool-util, preempt-rate.
